svg.aria-label: Sequence of one customer message. The browser posts the ticket; Flask saves it to SQLite and answers in about 6 milliseconds while the chat shows typing. Flask submits the case to an AI worker, which checks for a knowledge gap, analyses the message, looks up orders, decides who answers, writes the reply or handoff in the customer's language through the AI core and Gemini, then commits under the case lock about 7 seconds later. The browser polls, the reply appears and can be played aloud; if the case was handed over it joins the agent's queue.
